fullPassage: The common accounts of human nature that float around in society are generally a mixture of assumptions, tales and sometimes plain silliness. However, psychology is different. It is the branch of science that is devoted to understanding people: how and why we act as we do; why we see things as we do; and how we interact with one another. The key word here is 'science.' Psychologists don't depend on opinions and hearsay, or the generally accepted views of society at the time, or even the considered opinions of deep thinkers. Instead, they look for evidence, to make sure that psychological ideas are firmly based, and not just derived from generally held beliefs or assumptions. In addition to this evidence-based approach, psychology deals with fundamental processes and principles that generate our rich cultural and social diversity, as well as those shared by all human beings. These are what modern psychology is all about.

det.tip: account: ① (명사) 계좌 ② (명사) 설명/서술 ③ (동사) account for(설명하다/차지하다)

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "facts or signs that show that something is true"

det.analysis:
✅ ① evidence: evidence(증거)는 무언가가 사실임을 보여주는 사실·징표라는 영영 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ② assumption: assumption(가정)은 증명되지 않은 전제
❌ ③ opinion: opinion(의견)은 개인적 견해로 증거가 아님
❌ ④ hearsay: hearsay(소문)는 확인되지 않은 전언으로 증거와 반대

questions.passage: Psychologists don't depend on opinions and hearsay, or the generally __________ (acceptance) views of society at the time. Instead, they look for evidence, to make sure that psychological ideas are firmly based, and not just derived from generally held beliefs or assumptions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: 'the generally __________ views'에서 명사 views를 수식하는 과거분사가 필요하다. 명사 acceptance(수용)를 과거분사 accepted(받아들여진)로 변환. the generally accepted views = 일반적으로 받아들여진 견해
det.tip: acceptance(명사) → accepted(과거분사): generally accepted views

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

Psychologists __________, or the generally accepted views of society at the time, or even the considered opinions of deep thinkers. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸: 'don't depend on opinions and hearsay'(의견과 소문에 의존하지 않는다) — 과학으로서 심리학의 특징
det.analysis:
❌ ① always trust famous experts completely(유명 전문가를 전적으로 신뢰): 본문은 깊은 사상가의 의견조차 의존하지 않는다고 함
❌ ② prefer simple and popular explanations(단순하고 대중적인 설명 선호): 통념을 따르지 않는다는 내용과 반대

❌ ④ ignore all scientific experiments(모든 과학 실험을 무시): 심리학은 증거 기반이므로 반대
det.tip: Psychologists __________, or the generally accepted views — 의견·소문에 의존하지 않는다

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
